This unique index helps to identify hidden dysfunctional beliefs and thinking patterns.

Need for approval

Dependence on love

Achievement-driven self-worth

Perfectionism

Demands toward others

Need for control

Autonomy in life

This test will help you notice many hidden aspects of your thinking, identify areas that need attention, and lay the foundation for your personal growth strategy.
